title: Let code own the final decision-plane action with escalation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` with batched triage questions and fixture answers. He performs `run_recipe` and verifies code-owned policy accepts billing, rejects illegal choices, and escalates below the confidence floor.
